what: Crop-JEPA post-hoc follow-up (2x2: token cap x training length); exploratory, planned after the Stage C results were known

cap9k.role: post-hoc follow-up 2x2: Stage C token cap (K from Phase 0) at the Stage B length (9,030 steps)

uncap26k.role: post-hoc follow-up 2x2: Stage B token protocol (no cap) at the Stage C length (26,058 steps)

analysis.unit: seed (100-109); d = veg_pos - ijepa on the linear-probe primary endpoint (pp), per cell
analysis.statistics: mean, 95% seed-bootstrap CI (B = 10000), exact two-sided Wilcoxon; all EXPLORATORY (post hoc)
analysis.reading: the cap explains the loss of the Stage B effect if cap_at_9k has a 95% CI below 0 and length_uncapped includes 0; training length explains it if length_uncapped has a CI below 0 and cap_at_9k includes 0; both if both are below 0; neither alone is identified otherwise
